annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/611 amending Implementing Decision (EU) 2020/438 as regards harmonised standards on biological evaluation of medical devices, packaging for terminally sterilised medical devices, sterilisation of health care products and clinical investigation of medical devices for human subjects
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/611 amending Implementing Decision (EU) 2020/438 as regards harmonised standards on biological evaluation of medical devices, packaging for terminally sterilised medical devices, sterilisation of health care products and clinical investigation of medical devices for human subjects
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 129/158
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission Implementing Decision of 14 April 2021 updating the list of harmonised standards for active implantable medical devices under Directive 90/385/EEC, replacing references to revised ISO 10993, 11607, 11737 and 14155 standards and adding EN ISO 11607-2:2020. Compliance gives presumption of conformity.
key_provisions_or_claims: Amends Annex I of Implementing Decision (EU) 2020/438 with updated harmonised standard references
Replaces entries for EN ISO 10993-16, 10993-18, 11607-1, 11737-2 and 14155
Compliance with listed standards confers presumption of conformity with essential requirements
Enters into force on date of publication
